experiment_name: SEED-IV C2 E0 current and temporal utility, all sessions
parent_required_scope: same audited C1 E0 config for every session-target-seed; Session 3 E0 artifacts must be present and independently audited before full C2

preprocessing.normalization: existing zscore_subject_wise, separately per session and subject over all that subject's windows and time steps
preprocessing.time_index_unit: DE-LDS feature-frame index; no seconds inferred

inner_oof.split_algorithm: numpy SeedSequence([split_seed, session_id, outer_target_id]); permute the 14 non-target subject IDs; first 2 are D; permute remaining 12 and split in order into 3 folds of 4
inner_oof.teacher_checkpoint_rule: fixed final epoch 200; no heldout-label checkpoint selection
inner_oof.teacher_seed_rule: same configured run seed for each of the four teacher fits

router.candidate_pairs: all six unordered class pairs in ascending class-index order
router.candidate_selection: maximum predicted utility if positive, else no-op; ties follow source order then pair order
router.candidate_sample_weighting: equal total weight per sample, divided equally among its K*6 candidates
router.source_dev_checkpoint_rule: maximum mean source-dev-subject accuracy; tie-break lower mean CE then earliest epoch
router.target_checkpoint_rule: maximum target accuracy, earliest epoch on ties; target labels used only for this fixed report record

action.single_pair_logits: center(reference_logits); add action_alpha*residual/2 to class a and subtract it from class b

history.update_order: predict from current and prior state first, then update state with the current uncorrected reference/expert margins
history.first_window: zero history values and mask 0; initialize state from current margins after prediction

execution.known_parent_e0_gap_at_revision: Session 3 E0: 45 cells not found in audited parent path; full matrix blocked until completed and audited
